evals.name: minimal-fresh-scaffold
evals.prompt: Necesito un CLAUDE.md para este proyecto, es bien nuevo todavía casi sin código.
evals.expected_output: A CLAUDE.md grounded in the actual (minimal) repo state — real package.json scripts/deps, real (sparse) folder structure. Should NOT fabricate a rich architecture or UI rules that aren't there yet; should flag what's unknown/TBD or ask the user instead of inventing plausible-sounding content.
assertions: Does not invent commands beyond the real package.json script (only 'build': 'tsc' exists — no dev/lint/test scripts)
Does not fabricate an elaborate multi-folder architecture or UI/design-system rules that aren't present in this near-empty scaffold
Explicitly flags unknowns/TBD or asks the user for missing specifics instead of inventing generic content
Mentions the real tech stack detected (TypeScript, tsc build) grounded in package.json/tsconfig.json
Uses markdown ## headers matching the section structure from the skill

evals.name: backend-with-existing-agents-md
evals.prompt: Genera un CLAUDE.md para este microservicio NestJS. Ya existe un AGENTS.md, tenlo en cuenta.
evals.expected_output: A CLAUDE.md for a NestJS backend service that reflects real deps/scripts from package.json, real folder layout under src/, and does not contradict or duplicate what's already in AGENTS.md. Skips or minimizes UI/content sections since this is a backend service.
assertions: Reflects the real Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) layout described in AGENTS.md rather than a generic NestJS layout
Commands section only lists real package.json scripts — no invented commands
Does not silently duplicate or contradict AGENTS.md
Skips or minimizes UI/design-system and content/copy-guidance sections
Includes safe-change rules grounded in this project's real constraints

evals.name: full-app-nestjs-prisma
evals.prompt: Crea el CLAUDE.md de este proyecto para que Claude Code deje de asumir cosas raras del stack.
evals.expected_output: A complete CLAUDE.md covering the sections that apply to a NestJS + Prisma ticket platform, grounded in the actual repo (prisma/, src/, libs/), not generic NestJS boilerplate.
assertions: Tech stack section names the real stack with real dependencies from package.json (NestJS 10, Prisma 5)
Commands section only lists real package.json scripts
Architecture section reflects the real src/, libs/, prisma/ folder layout
Includes safe-change rules covering something concrete to this project (e.g. Prisma schema/migrations)
Only applicable sections are filled in with real content, no padding
